title: Jazix Additions
description: Jazix Additions aims to add weird and crazy things to your game, including: Feastables, Brain Cancer, and more!
body:
### **Jazix Additions** (This won't be updated much, just play the mod or read Changelog.)
This mod adds weird and crazy additions to your Minecraft, like:
- Feastables - When eaten, you are given Brain Cancer
- Tuff Block - A block thats tuff
- Tuff Plant - A Plant you can grow thats tuff
- Forbidden Chocolate - A block of chocolate that looks a little too much like poop.
- Suspicious Chocolate - Using this and rotten flesh you can craft the Feastables.
- Fat Levels increase when eating Chocolate, changing your player model.
